label: poisoned, and left it the Wardenry's moral cover
notes: RR 166: the well-string went drinkable to brackish to poison in a single season, the Wardenry rationed rather than closed because closing stranded four hundred people at the halfway point, and something over two hundred died between the wells and the rim. The Fourth Article followed the next spring. When the packet is opened at these wells in chapter 2 they are standing on the ground that produced the law that will be used against them - and the counter-reading nobody at Bell Harrow will hear is that the rationing order which killed them was the Wardenry's own.
